Before you conﬁgure VPCs to share OpenSearch Ingestion pipelines across AWS accounts, complete
the following tasks:
Conﬁguring pipelines for cross-account ingestion
309
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
Task
Details
Create one or more OpenSearch Ingestion
pipelines
Set the minimum OpenSearch Compute Units
(OSUs) to 2 or higher. For more information,
see Creating Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion
pipelines. For information about updating a
pipeline, see Updating Amazon OpenSearch
Ingestion pipelines.
Create one or more VPCs for OpenSearch
Ingestion
To enable cross-account pipeline sharing,
any VPC involved for the pipeline and the
pipeline endpoints must be conﬁgured with
the following DNS values:
• enableDnsSupport=true
• enableDnsHostnames=true
For more information, see DNS attributes for
your VPC in the Amazon VPC User Guide.
